requirements.arithmetic: Independent scalar transition implementation must not import primary update/calculation helpers; fixed before/after goldens are evaluator-only.
requirements.comparison: Compare an independently implemented scalar transition with the same-role event-driven engine, same delivered outcomes and actual update allocation; fixture engine labels are not runtime equality.
requirements.delay: Consume only matured outcome receipts; source timestamp precedes delivery, no same-tick or future outcome credit; duplicate receipt rejected.
requirements.identity: Receiving ID and shuffled source ID remain distinct; bind owner, route, key, side and trusted predecessor independently of candidate output.
requirements.phases: Training state and diagnostic state are separate; diagnostic selection cannot write learning state; permanent fixed and shuffled roles remain separate.
requirements.scope: Hand snapshots establish arithmetic only, not runtime write provenance, complete learner equivalence, independent task usefulness or SNN causality.
requirements.types: Exact integer versus float types, finite nonnegative values, no negative zero; exact binary64 hex equality for floats and strict no-op rejection.
requirements.writes: Return a new state from a fixed predecessor; require 36 genuinely changed fields and 399 unchanged fields, nine route credits, no absorbed additions.
